en.title: Cloud-security podcast: attributed isolation and learning advice

claims.text: In the transcript, Edera co-founder Alex Zenla describes a zone abstraction for isolating workloads inside virtual machines. This is the vendor speaker’s account of the design, not an independently tested security boundary.

evidence.quote: we have this concept called a zone that allows you to run isolated workloads inside of a safe virtual machine.

claims.text: Zenla describes using language models to explain specifications and emphasizes understanding the resulting implementation. The interview’s criticism of existing infrastructure is an attributed engineering viewpoint, not proof that every container or GPU deployment is insecure.
